title: Tenma Tsukasa — Sinking Into Despair〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff!
We're keeping a good pace!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Go, Tsukasa, go♪
Let's finish up strong☆

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We're almost there!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Right! Time to buckle down and sprint!
Raise the pace!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Roar*

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm not about to fall behind!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Huff, huff...! Phew...!
Ten laps around the park...done!
bgm_area00004

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
We worked up a fine sweat!
Are you two tired at all?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Nope, I'm fine!
It's lots of fun to run with everyone!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, I could keep going for ages!
Ten laps is a good warm-up.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: W-Warm-up?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I-I've always known you two had stamina, but... That is truly impressive.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You need stamina to give your best performance! I need to build just as much stamina as you have!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Stamina, huh...
What kind of training do you do for that, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hmm... Well...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, I have just the thing! Do you want to try my special stamina-building regimen together?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, of course!
What kind of training is it?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You pick up that pot over there, and dash over to the Ferris wheel with it!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It builds stamina while also strengthening your arms, back, legs and hips... You can work on different areas all at once.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, I see!
A straightforward routine to build pure strength.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Ooh, that sounds like fun☆
Okay, I'll do it too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Excellent. Then, I'll take this pot...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hrrrrrggh...! Nnnngh...?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hrrrgh!!!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You can do it! Keep at it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hrgh! Gah! I can't...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I-I don't think I can either...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Huh? What's wrong, you two?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: N-Nothing is wrong with us! These flowerpots refuse to move an inch!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They're so heavy, we can't even lift them!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's weird... I don't remember them being that heavy...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! She just...lifted it?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow, MEIKO, you're amazing!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe, thanks! I can see how this might be a little too heavy for you two, though.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'll just put this back down...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Even just setting it down made such an intimidating sound...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm sorry, MEIKO, but I think I'd need a separate training regimen just to prepare for this training regimen.
Oh? What are you three up to?
se_walk_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, I was doing some training with Miku and MEIKO's gracious company.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The contest just ended, and you're still so motivated.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You've been practicing so hard lately, we thought for sure you'd relax a bit!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I did intend to at first, but my mind has been thoroughly changed.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I spoke with Asahi on the way home from the contest... And he said something unthinkable to me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: He said that he didn't want to lose to me...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: An actor of his caliber, saying such a thing to me... I was completely taken aback.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But it truly is an honor. It means he sees me as his rival.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I did think you seemed peppy lately. That explains why!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: His rival, huh... It must be a wonderful feeling to have someone you respect so much acknowledge your ability.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. His words have lit a fire in my heart!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I must learn more, work harder...and aim for ever greater heights!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ooh! You're fired up!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
And so, I plan to rehearse like mad today!
That's enough exercise for now. It's time for acting practice!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If you'd like, you're all more than welcome to join!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Of course!
